content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00189 The McSupportData element and its sub-structure shall be self-contained in the sense that there is no need to deliver the whole upstream descriptions of the ECU (including the ECU Extract, Software Component descriptions, Basic Software Module descriptions, ECU Configuration Values descriptions, Flat Map, etc.) in order to later generate the final "A2L"-file. This means that the RTE Generator has to copy the re- quired information from the upstream descriptions into the McSupportData element.
